whatIncluded.question: Which services does PJ Cranes offer?
whatIncluded.answer: We support buying from stock, selling your crane, targeted sourcing, transport & shipping, and documentation & export.

pricing.question: Are prices inclusive of transport?
pricing.answer: No. Machine prices are on request. Transport and delivery are quoted separately based on route and timing.

stockOrSource.question: What if the crane is not in stock?
stockOrSource.answer: We source through our network. Share brand, model, capacity and timing — we come back with options.

international.question: Do you work internationally?
international.answer: Yes. From Nijkerk we trade internationally and support cross-border handover, including documentation where needed.

transportDocs.question: Can I use transport or documentation on their own?
transportDocs.answer: Yes. Those tracks can be part of a machine purchase, or requested separately via contact.

contact.question: How do I start?
contact.answer: Choose the relevant service above, or contact sales directly. We will guide you to the right next step.

meta.title: Über PJ Cranes | Internationaler Handel mit Mobilkranen
meta.description: Erfahren Sie mehr über PJ Cranes, Spezialist für internationalen An- und Verkauf gebrauchter Mobilkrane über fünf weltweite Büros.

hero.title: Mehr als 20 Jahre internationaler Kranhandel
hero.subtitle: PJ Cranes verbindet Käufer und Verkäufer gebrauchter Mobilkrane über fünf Büros und ein weltweites Netzwerk.
hero.support: Von Ankauf und Verkauf bis Dokumentation und Übergabe.
hero.imageAlt: Mobilkran von PJ Cranes für den internationalen Handel

story.title: Spezialisierte Marktkenntnis, weltweit eingesetzt
body: PJ Cranes ist seit mehr als 20 Jahren im An- und Verkauf gebrauchter Mobilkrane tätig. Vom Hauptsitz in Nijkerk begleiten wir internationale Käufer und Verkäufer bei Maschinen von Marken wie Liebherr, Grove, Terex-Demag und Tadano Faun.

Mit fünf Büros und einem internationalen Netzwerk verbinden wir verfügbare Maschinen mit relevanter Nachfrage — typisch von etwa 20 bis 1000 Tonnen. Spezifikationen stehen pro Inserat; Preise immer auf Anfrage.
Sie behalten einen festen Ansprechpartner: von der ersten Such- oder Verkaufsanfrage bis zu Dokumentation, Exportkoordination und Transport, wenn erforderlich.

network.title: Unser weltweites Netzwerk
network.description: Von Europa über den Nahen Osten bis in die Vereinigten Staaten — über unsere Büros und den internationalen Markt sind wir weltweit aktiv.

expertise.title: Erfahrung in jedem Schritt der Transaktion

meta.title: FAQ
meta.description: Answers about delivery, documents, origin, payment and inspection at PJ Cranes.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: Short answers on how we buy, sell and deliver cranes. Missing your question? Contact us.

countries.question: Which countries have you been in business with?
countries.answer: P.J. Cranes has done business with different people and companies all over the world. Feel free to contact us if you have a question regarding the possibilities of buying or selling from a specific continent or country.

experience.question: How long has P.J. Cranes been in business for?
experience.answer: P.J. Cranes has been a nested name within the crane industry for more than 20 years. With a family that has been in the market for decades, P.J. Cranes has a wide knowledge and a great network which guarantees the best service and most suitable offer for our clients.

delivery.question: Does P.J. Cranes organize delivery?
delivery.answer: At a client's request, we will deliver cranes wherever you desire (from port to doorstep). Delivery is not included in the original cost of the crane and will be calculated separately.

origin.question: Where do the cranes P.J. Cranes sells come from?
origin.answer: P.J. Cranes B.V. sources the best cranes from all over the world. We have a vast and reliable network of suppliers of used cranes with whom we have been working with for years. The majority of the cranes we sell are originating Germany, France, the Netherlands and Belgium.

condition.question: How is the condition of the cranes?
condition.answer: All details of each crane are described on the technical data sheets. We sell cranes from different suppliers, origins and construction years. Evidently all our cranes are in perfect working condition and are carefully investigated before selling.

payment.question: What are the payment methods P.J. Cranes uses?
payment.answer: We accept payments through TT bank transfer or via a letter of credit (L/C).

inspectionVisit.question: How and where can I see the cranes?
inspectionVisit.answer: The cranes can be inspected in our yard in the Netherlands or at our suppliers' terrain. To keep costs as low as possible we don't ship to the Netherlands if it isn't necessary.

documents.question: What documents will I get when purchasing a crane?
documents.answer: Usually these include the crane's passport, certificate of origin, service book, parts catalog, user manual and other necessary documents. For the exact content of the package of documents, we will inform you at the time of the crane purchase.

thirdPartyInspection.question: Does P.J. Cranes supply third party inspection reports?
thirdPartyInspection.answer: We organize third party inspections of the crane on request.

deliveryTime.question: How long will it take to have a purchased crane delivered?
deliveryTime.answer: Usually all of the cranes we offer are available immediately. Delivery times differ on the current location of a crane. Feel free to get in touch with us when you have a question regarding the delivery time of a certain crane.

ownership.question: Does P.J. Cranes own the cranes they sell?
ownership.answer: 80% of our stock is owned by us. For the other 20% we work on a consignment base with our suppliers.
